about.title: About & Downloads
about.description: What {brand} is and how to use it; download all HD posters and datasets; CC BY 4.0 attribution format.
about.lead: 350 layout and composition teaching posters, each explaining one technique: what it is, its key points, and when to use it. Organized into {cats} categories and {subs} topics—searchable, downloadable, and ready to prompt.
about.how1: Pick a category tab in the Atlas, or type in the top search bar to search by name, ID, English title, key points, or keywords.
about.how2: Open any poster for a larger view; click the image for actual size so even small print stays legible. Switch versions where a second version exists.
about.how3: Download HD (WebP, 1086 × 1448), or Copy prompt for a concise composition block you can append to your image prompt.
about.how4: Favorite candidates while planning a project, then copy the list (ID + name) in one click from Favorites in the atlas. Favorites are stored in this browser only.
about.zip: All 350 HD posters (ZIP): original PNGs via GitHub Release.
about.zip100: Classic 100 posters (ZIP): the original "100 Layouts" set.
about.data: Dataset: CSV (opens directly in spreadsheets) · JSON (for programmatic use). Fields include ID, name, category, topic, image path, dimensions, and SHA-256.
about.licenseText: Images and data are licensed under CC BY 4.0: you may share, redistribute, and adapt them, including for commercial use, with credit and an indication of any changes. Suggested attribution:
about.textBody: Definitions, key points, usage notes, and keywords on detail pages are transcribed directly from the posters: two models transcribed each independently, compared field by field, and any discrepancies were reviewed by hand. Transcribed verbatim with nothing added. If you spot an error, please let us know on GitHub Issues.
about.translated: The interface and poster text in this language were translated from Chinese by AI; the poster images themselves remain in Chinese. If you spot a translation issue, please report it on GitHub Issues.
about.vip: Member site: Xiaoxiaodong Member Prompt Library
